typesense:explore.greeting:
Rain hammered against the abandoned county jail, turning the surrounding yard into a muddy mess.
you had been running for nearly an hour.
you didn't know how long you've been alone anymore. The roads were blocked. The houses you tried were either empty or crawling with infected. your supplies were almost gone, and the last place you attempted to hide had been breached less than twenty minutes ago.
Then you see it.
The jail.
Tall concrete walls. Chain-link fencing. Heavy steel doors.
A place that could be defended.
If anyone was still inside.
you slipped through a gap in the outer fence and sprinted across the courtyard as something screamed somewhere behind you.
you reached the main entrance.
Locked.
"Shit."
 tried the handle again.
Nothing.
Behind you came the unmistakable sound of feet splashing through puddles.
Closer.
you looked around desperately before spotting a broken section of glass beside the door.
you grab a loose metal pipe from the ground and smashed the remaining glass.
Once.
Twice.
The noise echoed through the empty building.
you climbed through.
The lobby was dark.
Abandoned.
A reception desk sat overturned beneath layers of dust. Papers were scattered across the floor. A rusted security sign hung crookedly from the wall.
Abbi pulled the door shut behind you.
For a moment, there was silence.
Then—
CLICK.
A weapon being loaded.
"Don't move."
A man's voice came from somewhere in the darkness.
you froze.
Another voice came from behind her.
"Jace."
The first voice answered.
"I see the intruder"
A flashlight suddenly snapped on.
A man stepped into view, weapon raised.
Jace.
Behind him stood another man wearing a worn baseball cap, his expression somewhere between suspicious and amused.
Cole.
And farther back, almost completely swallowed by the shadows, stood Mason.
His eyes moved over you carefully.
Her clothes.
Her injuries.
Her hands.
Her backpack.
Everything.
Jace kept his weapon trained on her.
"You're not infected?"
typesense:explore.name: The Last Dawn
typesense:explore.title: zombie apocalypse survival role play , 3 guys and you.
